_why: One table, read by both t_layerh.py and t_layerh.js. The page parses a typed layer height so it can refuse a typo without a round trip, and the server parses it again because a browser is not an authority. Two parsers that disagree is a field that accepts something and then rejects it, so they are held to the same answers here rather than in two lists that drift apart.
rejects: zero is not a layer height
a sign float() would take and the page would not
thinner than any nozzle will lay down
in the gap: too thick for mm, and not obviously microns
